Text: Pedro and I worked together to iterate and improve on the delivery process model as part of the integration between Gluo and Orium. He's diligent and thoughtful in his approach and brought a lot of great ideas to how we might improve things. I also found Pedro to be a great listener and he asked really good questions throughout the process. I really enjoyed working with Pedro.

Pedro is a colleague who has a great ability to share knowledge and guide teams. He is constantly looking for ways to grow and learn, staying up to date with best practices and tools that help streamline his daily work. He makes excellent use of his knowledge of agile delivery frameworks and practices, both for team management and for client communication. He has received outstanding reviews from the clients he has worked with. I highly recommend him to lead any digital transformation initiative.

I had the opportunity to collaborate with Pedro Zambrano, and I can confidently say he is one of the most effective delivery managers and process leaders I've worked with.  Pedro brings a rare blend of strategic thinking, hands-on project execution, and a deep understanding of how to drive transformation through technology. His leadership in implementing Agile Release Trains, standardizing project management practices, and optimizing delivery workflows has directly resulted in measurable improvements — faster delivery cycles, reduced costs, and aligned cross-functional teams.  What stands out most is Pedro’s ability to lead with clarity and empathy. He inspires trust, drives accountability, and always keeps the bigger picture in focus. Whether he's managing complex IT initiatives or guiding multidisciplinary teams, Pedro consistently delivers outcomes that exceed expectations.  If you’re looking for a forward-thinking leader who gets things done and makes everyone around him better, Pedro is the one you want in your corner.  I highly recommend Pedro for any organization looking to transform, grow, and deliver at scale.
